Doctors Warn of Skin Condition from Excessive Device Use

Medical professionals are issuing warnings about "toasted skin syndrome," a condition observed in children due to prolonged exposure to heat emitted by electronic devices. This condition, characterized by skin redness and discoloration resembling a tan, is linked to the overuse of smartphones, tablets, and laptops. Doctors advise limiting screen time and maintaining a safe distance between devices and the skin to prevent the condition. The syndrome is a growing concern as children increasingly rely on electronics for education and entertainment.
